definitions.explanation: Describes something that deviates from what is considered normal or standard. Can be neutral, negative (something is wrong), or positive (something is exceptionally good).

examples.japanese: あの{人|ひと}の{行動|こうどう}は{普通|ふつう}でない。
examples.english: That person's behavior is not normal.

examples.japanese: {普通|ふつう}でない{暑|あつ}さが{続|つづ}いている。
{彼女|かのじょ}の{才能|さいのう}は{普通|ふつう}でない。{将来|しょうらい}が{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: Her talent is extraordinary. I look forward to her future.

examples.japanese: この{状況|じょうきょう}は{普通|ふつう}ではないので、{専門家|せんもんか}に{相談|そうだん}したほうがいい。
examples.english: This situation is not normal, so you should consult a specialist.

notes:
Composed of {普通|ふつう} (normal; ordinary) + でない (is not). In polite speech, becomes {普通|ふつう}ではない or {普通|ふつう}ではありません. Can modify nouns: {普通|ふつう}でない{量|りょう} (an unusual amount).

The tone depends on context:
- Negative: something is wrong or alarming ({普通|ふつう}でない{様子|ようす} — an abnormal appearance)
- Positive: something is impressively exceptional ({普通|ふつう}でない{実力|じつりょく} — extraordinary ability)
- Neutral: simply noting deviation from the norm

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {普通|ふつう}でない{量|りょう}: an unusual amount
- {普通|ふつう}でない{状態|じょうたい}: an abnormal state
- {普通|ふつう}でない{才能|さいのう}: extraordinary talent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {異常|いじょう}: abnormal; anomalous — stronger and more formal, often implies a problem
- {尋常|じんじょう}でない: extraordinary; out of the ordinary — literary, emphasizes extreme deviation
- {変|へん}: strange; odd — more casual and subjective
